messages:
anya: FYI invoice-preview showed a weird bump for several small tenants after the serializer-compact canary at 02:12 UTC. Not an outage, but preview deltas jumped ~1.6%.
sam: I pulled traces. There's a pattern where requests routed through compat-mode lose route_label and later the enricher emits a separate billing_event with a new billing_id. Preview ends up with both the original and the enriched emit.
mike: Example payload from the canary shard (sanitized):
```
{
  "tenant": "t-47",
  "req_hash": "abc123",
  "route_label": null,
  "tokens": 64,
  "emitted_by": "edge-router-compat",
  "billing_event_id": "evt-0001"
}
```
mike: Later post-enrichment we see:
```
{
  "tenant": "t-47",
  "req_hash": "abc123",
  "route_label": "sdk-default",
  "tokens": 64,
  "emitted_by": "enricher",
  "billing_event_id": "evt-0001-1"
}
```
anya: So two billable records for the same logical request. Aggregator currently dedupes on billing_event_id only.
data-jen: That's brittle. We should instead dedupe on a deterministic fingerprint: sha256(tenant || req_hash || model_alias). billing_event_id should be best-effort, not canonical.
linda: Quick mitigation idea: aggregator preview pipeline can apply a preview-only post-aggregation step that collapses records with identical fingerprint and overlapping window (5s). Low risk because only affects preview.
billing-bot: Reminder: preview collapser still needs finance-aware signoff if it affects previewed invoice amounts > $50k in aggregate. See /policies/billing-preview.json
sam: Also propose a short-lived enricher tweak: emit enriched event with original billing_event_id in the metadata (orig_billing_id) when route_label was absent. That keeps aggregator backward-compatible.
mike: Agreed. I'll open a small change to enricher to copy orig id and add a flag `enriched_from_compat`.
data-jen: I'll spin up a reducer job to run in the preview sandbox that groups by the new fingerprint and reports delta.csv. If we can show the net preview change is mostly <1% and concentrated in compat-mode tenants, we can push a fast patch.
anya: Dashboard work: add a `billing_dup_rate` metric (per-route, per-tenant) and a `compat_mode_loss` histogram so PMs and SOC can watch during rollouts.
linda: I'll add alert thresholds: warn at 0.3% cluster-wide or 0.1% for any single tenant over 24h.
billing-bot: Deploy windows: do not change production aggregator within 30m of invoice snapshot (03:00 UTC). Any preview-only jobs are OK.
anya: Action items: mike 1: enricher change to include orig id (owner)
anya: data-jen 1: reducer run + delta.csv (owner)
anya: sam 1: preview-only collapser toggle behind feature flag `preview_collapser_v1` (owner)
anya: linda 1: dashboard+alerts (owner)
anya: I'll coordinate with finance and schedule merges after reducer run. Aim: hotfix to canary within 2h, preview-collapser flip if results look good.
mike: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/enricher/pulls/2049 (draft)
sam: Feature flag ready in frontend. Will gate by org and canary regions.
data-jen: Reducer run started. Initial pass shows 1.2% of preview value comes from compat-mode path; most are sub-$10 tenants.
anya: Great. If the numbers hold we'll proceed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
